title: Full Metal Daemon Muramasa: The Crimson Spider
alt: A night scene. A spider of crimson steel, far greater than a man, stands and hangs on thin threads in front of a huge full moon. It has a round body in bands with two rings of gold, a smaller fore part with two yellow eyes and two fangs, and eight long legs in plates with black joints. Under it, near us, a man in a long dark coat stands with his back to us and holds a drawn sword low at his side. The ground is flat stones lit orange by two baskets of fire. At each side stands a great dark tree with a thick straw rope round it and white folded papers that hang from the rope. Plume grass grows at the edge of the yard.
summary: A painting of Muramasa as the crimson spider from Full Metal Daemon Muramasa in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Full Metal Daemon Muramasa, the visual novel by Nitroplus. A tsurugi is a suit of armour with a mind of its own. When no one wears it, it has the shape of a beast. Muramasa has the shape of a great crimson spider.

The man is Minato Kageaki. When he calls, the spider comes apart and closes on him as his armour. The armour has a law: for each enemy that it kills, it must kill one that he loves. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
